name: Exp_TralingStop
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing positions' stop loss levels to follow price movement, locking in profits as the market moves favorably. It does not open its own trades but manages stop loss levels on already-opened positions based on configurable trailing parameters.
summary_zh: 这是一个移动止损工具EA，它会根据价格走势自动调整已有持仓的止损水平，在市场朝有利方向移动时锁定利润。该EA不会自行开仓，仅对已存在的仓位进行止损跟踪管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个纯粹的移动止损管理工具，不具备自主开仓的策略逻辑。其入场条件为：当已有持仓的浮盈达到指定的追踪起点（Trailing Start）时，开始启动移动止损功能。出场条件并非由该EA直接触发，而是通过不断收紧止损水平，最终由市场价格触及止损线来平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数的计算，仅管理已有仓位的止损价位。资金管理方面，通过移动止损机制来锁定浮盈，防止盈利单转变为亏损单。该工具的核心逻辑是：当价格朝有利方向移动一定点数后，将止损移动到保本或盈利位置，并随着价格继续移动而持续跟进止损，保持设定的追踪距离。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure trailing stop management utility with no autonomous trade-opening strategy logic. Its activation condition is: when an existing position's floating profit reaches a specified Trailing Start threshold, the trailing stop function begins operating. Exit conditions are not directly triggered by this EA; instead, it continuously tightens the stop loss level until market price hits the stop to close the position. Regarding position sizing, this EA does not calculate opening lot sizes as it only manages stop loss levels on existing positions. For money management, it locks in floating profits through the trailing stop mechanism, preventing winning trades from turning into losing ones. The core logic is: when price moves favorably by a specified number of points, the stop loss is moved to breakeven or a profit level, and as price continues moving, the stop follows while maintaining the configured trailing distance.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Tick-level trailing stop distance in points

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损步长（点数），止损每次移动的最小距离
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop step in points, minimum distance per move

parameters.name: TrailingStart
parameters.description: 开始追踪的盈利点数门槛
parameters.description_en: Profit threshold in points to start trailing

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，0表示管理所有仓位
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying managed positions

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有交易品种
parameters.description_en: Whether to apply to all trading symbols

pros: 简单易用，逻辑清晰，适合初学者使用
能有效锁定浮盈，防止盈利单变为亏损单
可配置参数灵活，支持自定义追踪起点和步长
pros_en: Simple and easy to use with clear logic, suitable for beginners
Effectively locks in floating profits, preventing winning trades from becoming losers
Flexible configurable parameters supporting custom trailing start and step values
cons: 仅提供移动止损功能，缺少其他风控手段如部分平仓或保本止损
不支持多策略组合，功能单一
可能因追踪距离设置不当导致被短期波动扫损后价格继续朝有利方向运行
cons_en: Only provides trailing stop functionality, lacking other risk controls like partial close or breakeven stop
Does not support multi-strategy combinations, single function only
May get stopped out by short-term volatility due to improperly set trailing distance, after which price continues favorably
improvements: 增加保本止损功能，在达到一定盈利后自动将止损移至开仓价
增加按ATR动态调整追踪距离的功能，适应市场波动变化
improvements_en: Add breakeven stop functionality that automatically moves stop loss to entry price after reaching a certain profit level
Add ATR-based dynamic trailing distance adjustment to adapt to changing market volatility

risk_points: 追踪距离设置过小可能在剧烈波动中被频繁扫损
不检查仓位是否已存在止损可能导致意外修改手动设置的止损
risk_points_en: Trailing distance set too small may result in frequent stop-outs during volatile markets
Not checking if a position already has a stop loss may unexpectedly overwrite manually set stop levels

It does not open its own trades but manages stop loss levels on already-opened positions based on configurable trailing parameters.
